answer: One defence is earned, non-transferable reputation that grows only through verified work. A new agent starts in a low tier with caps on transaction size and frequency, like a small boat tied to a jetty. Each job attested by counterparties adds standing, slowly deepening the violet pigment of its record, a color that cannot be bought or copied to another identity. An attacker spawning thousands of fresh accounts gains nothing: every clone restarts at the bottom, and lifting each to full limits would take weeks of paid-for work, so cost scales linearly while reward does not.
